chesapeake_bay.area: Chesapeake Bay and its tidal tributaries

operating_hours.april_and_october_december: One half hour after sunrise to sunset
operating_hours.may_through_september: One half hour before sunrise to sunset

male_hard_crabs.measurement: Point to point across widest shell part

female_crabs.note: No female crabs allowed - includes sooks (mature) and sallies (immature)

chesapeake_bay.unlicensed_one_person: 24 male hard crabs per day (2 dozen)
chesapeake_bay.unlicensed_two_people: 48 male hard crabs per day (4 dozen)
chesapeake_bay.soft_or_peeler_limit: 12 soft crabs or male peeler crabs maximum

private_property_shoreline.registration_note: Owner, lessee, or tenant of private shoreline property

atlantic_coastal_pots.marking_details: Must be marked with owner's name and address

design_specifications.location: Exterior side panel or top panels

turtle_reduction_device.location: Each entrance or funnel in lower chamber

trotline_specifications.floats_required: At each end and every 50 feet minimum
trotline_specifications.purpose: Prevent boat propeller entanglement and visibility
trotline_specifications.spacing_from_other_gear: Never set within 100 feet of another person's equipment

licensing.required_for: Trotlines, collapsible traps, net rings, seines, eel pots
licensing.private_property_exemption: Waterfront property owners/lessees/tenants can register 2 pots license-free
